lines.meet: ¡Órale, a fan! I'm Héctor, El Relámpago de Plata, the Silver Lightning, and now a witch doctor too. You want an autograph? Of course you do.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're at the Arena too, {carnal|carnala}, I've seen you in the stands! I'm Héctor, in the room under them.
lines.ask_home: Tell me, {carnal|carnala}, which neighbourhood made you? Every fighter comes from somewhere.
lines.ask_work: And before this, what was your act? Everybody has an act, even the quiet ones.
lines.answer_home: Mexico City, Tepito, a tough neighbourhood, {carnal|carnala}. My father traded in the market there.
lines.answer_work: Fifteen years of lucha libre, Friday nights at Arena México, as El Relámpago de Plata. Black mask, silver flames.
lines.chat_food: Tacos al pastor from the stand outside the arena, after a match, with a cold beer. ¡A la verga, that's paradise!
lines.chat_sleep: I always sleep facing the door, {carnal|carnala}, always. It's bad luck the other way, every luchador knows that.
lines.chat_missing: Rocío laughing at me while she sewed my masks, by hand, every one. Nobody else ever knew my face.
lines.chat_here: The troll spirits are no stranger than the saints my mother prayed to. I talk to both, {carnal|carnala}, just in case.
lines.tease_quiet: A face like a closed mask, {name}! Smile for the crowd, {carnal|carnala}, they paid good money.
lines.tease_talker: You could sell out the arena with that mouth, {name}! Almost as good as me, almost.
lines.tease_careful: You'd check the ropes ten times before the bell, {name}. A good habit, and very boring to watch.
lines.tease_bold: Off the top rope with no plan, {name}! I love it, but my knees don't.
lines.tease_any: You're my number one fan, {name}, I've decided. No, you don't get a choice.
lines.tease_back: ¡Órale, {name}, a clean pin! I'm down for the count.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, {name}, that's true. Rocío would say the same.
lines.bristle: Careful, {carnal|carnala}, that's close to the mask. Don't touch the mask.
lines.apologise: Perdón, that was a cheap shot, and I don't do cheap shots. I'm sorry, really.
lines.double_down: I say it, I mean it, {carnal|carnala}. That's how a luchador talks.
lines.needle_quiet: You stand there with no face at all, and nobody knows what you're thinking. At least wear a mask.
lines.needle_talker: Even I give the crowd a moment of silence before the big move. You never stop.
lines.needle_careful: You wait so long the crowd goes home. Give them something!
lines.needle_bold: You go off the top rope without looking where you'll land. One day it'll be the floor.
lines.needle_any: You think lucha is fake. I can see it on your face, and you're wrong.
lines.bite_back: I've been slammed through tables for fifteen years, {carnal|carnala}. You think that hurts me?
lines.hurt: Ay, that one got through the mask. Okay, I'll go back to my corner.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, I've had whole arenas boo me, {carnal|carnala}! You'll need more people than that.
lines.confide: {name}, for fifteen years nobody outside my family saw my face. Rocío sewed every mask I ever wore. A luchador's mask is his name.
lines.listen: That stays behind the mask, {name}. I promise you, on my mother.
lines.look_out: Stay in my corner in there, {name}! I'll take the big hits, that's my job.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, you call the match this time, and I'll follow.
lines.deflect: Ha, this little thing? I've been hurt worse falling out of the ring, {name}, so look after the rest.
lines.check_in: Up, up, {name}, talk to me! How many fingers, {carnal|carnala}?
lines.blame: Somebody botched the spot in there, and we all went down. You know who you are.
lines.thank: Off the canvas and back on my feet, thanks to you, {carnal|carnala}! Front row seats for you, forever.
lines.brush_off: Ha, it's nothing, {carnal|carnala}! The show must go on.
lines.worry: Ay, {name}, I thought the match was over! Stay down a second, let me look.
lines.handed_down: Look at me, {carnal|carnala}, in your gear! I'll make it famous, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, {carnal|carnala}! It looks good on you, and I've got my mask.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody asked the Silver Lightning? Okay, okay, but I noticed.
lines.turn_friendly: You're in my corner now, {name}, and I'm in yours. That's lucha, that's for life.
lines.turn_friends: When I've got my lucha night, {name}, you're walking out with me. Family walks out with you.
lines.turn_grating: You and me, we're not a good tag team. That's okay, not every match works.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still take the hits for you in there, because that's my job. Don't expect me to wave.
lines.make_up: Okay, {name}, let's shake hands in the middle of the ring and start over. That's how it's done.
lines.defend: Hey, hey, that's a cheap shot! Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The stands feel empty with my best fan, {name}, away for a while.
lines.friend_back: And here comes {name}, back in the ring! ¡Órale, I missed you!
lines.common_ring: Fifteen years in the ring, {carnal|carnala}, and you've been in one too, I can tell from your feet. I respect that.
lines.common_sport: I trained from fourteen and fought until my knee went. Anybody who's competed knows the training is the real fight.
lines.common_spanish: You speak Spanish! Finally, {carnal|carnala}, somebody I can really talk to.
lines.common_mexico: Mexican, like me! Where from, {carnal|carnala}? If you're from the capital, we're already family.
lines.common_parent: My two boys wear homemade masks to school and want to be luchadores. Rocío says it's my fault, and she's right.
